notes: παρεισῆλθεν → 'came in besides' and ὑπερεπερίσσευσεν → 'did abound more exceedingly' keep their preverb-realizing particles inside the verb's own unit, headed on the verb word (rule 106); no preposition is expressed in either clause to answer to the preverb.
νόμος → 'the law' is an anarthrous noun with a supplied determiner as an ordinary rule 7 helper (rule 51).
